context7.description: Up-to-date docs and code examples for this stack: Next.js 16 App Router, React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Supabase JS/SSR, GSAP, Zod.

supabase.description: Official Supabase MCP for the local (127.0.0.1:54321) or hosted database: run SQL, inspect schema/RLS, manage auth. Requires one-time OAuth sign-in via `/mcp login supabase`; no secrets are stored in this file.

next-devtools.description: Next.js dev-server diagnostics (runtime errors, routes, dev overlay) while `npm run dev` is running. Requires Linux Node via nvm inside WSL.
